adjusted_volatile_messages: Prepare the requested reusable draft without executing any operation.
composition_summary: Drafted one unapproved pure-logic class22 component pc-transfer-00. Raw offset may be absent or any JSON value; accepts exact integers -4..5 inclusive (bool/float rejected); always returns {accepted:boolean, offset:original if accepted else null}. A helper inspects_offset validates type and range and returns the complete object; the module invokes it and assigns its returned object to result. No imports, I/O, host calls, Tool dispatch, submission, Q1/Q2 or activation. Target typed inputs requires selected-runner support.
